description: This file defines the 'Topic' model class within the Opencart e-commerce framework. It provides methods to retrieve individual topics, a list of topics, and layout IDs associated with topics from the database.

classes.name: Topic
classes.description: The Topic class provides methods to fetch topic data, list of topics, and associated layout IDs from the database within the Opencart framework.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Retrieves a specific topic record from the database based on the provided topic ID, using caching for efficiency.

methods.name: getTopics
methods.description: Fetches all active topic records from the database, returning an array of topics.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Retrieves the layout ID associated with a given topic ID.
